route.name: Lagny - Paris via Marne 37 km ENG 2023

course_points.n: Turn left onto Rue de Marne
Turn left ; cross canal then turn right
Continue straight; stay on left side of the road
Bear left; cross bridge; stay on left side of the road
Turn left to go to the castle and cafe
Turn right onto Rue de Paris
Turn right onto Rue de Paris to continue ride
Turn left onto Promenade des Pâtis
Continue straight onto Quai de la Marne
At roundabout, take exit 1 onto Quai du Viaduc
Turn left onto Rue du Port
Turn right; cross road and turn right again
Cross road then turn left onto bike path
Turn sharp left onto Quai de Bir-Hakeim
Bear right onto Place de l'Écluse
Turn left onto Allée du Moulin des Corbeaux
Bear left onto Port de la Rapée
